about_the_game:
Pegasis Odyssey is a retro-style, pixel art shoot’em up where you embark on a space adventure. Explore different biomes with unique enemies and bosses, gather resources, and upgrade your ship to face tougher challenges.

As you progress through various environments, each offering different combat patterns and tactical choices, you’ll collect valuable resources to enhance your arsenal. The deeper you go, the more intense the challenges become, and when it’s too overwhelming, it’s time to reset.

Each reset allows you to invest points into powerful upgrades, making your journey through the cosmos easier with every loop. Customize your ship, test new strategies, and experience a fresh start every time you reset.

Key Features:

  • Retro Pixel Art Style: Dive into a unique pixel art universe crafted with care, filled with distinct biomes and enemies.

  • Incremental Gameplay: Collect resources, upgrade your ship, and face increasingly tough enemies. When it gets too hard, reset and grow stronger.

  • Randomized Spawn Patterns: Encounter varied enemy formations and boss battles with every run.

  • Challenging Biomes: Explore a range of environments, each with its own enemies and bosses.

  • Deep Progression System: Unlock new abilities and upgrades for your ship, allowing you to push further into the unknown.

Pegasis Odyssey combines the fast-paced action of a shoot’em up with the addictive progression of an idle game, wrapped in a nostalgic retro aesthetic. It’s perfect for players who enjoy challenging, action-packed idle with a strategic touch.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
